gpu_analysis.scope: Disjoint appearance passes grouped by identical options, resolution and event kind. GPU sum excludes CPU, transport and uninstrumented engine work. Largest GPU pass is not proof of a whole-system bottleneck.

passes.scope: same resolution/options; changed-image solves including cold work; cached idle has no new samples

diagnostic.scope: Current options; three camera, three radiometry and three source-position changes. Event latency ends at CPU render submission, not GPU completion; use asynchronous GPU timestamps for GPU cost.
